historical_references.reference: Agastya Muni is revered as one of the Saptarishis (Seven Sages) in Hindu mythology. He is believed to have lived during the Treta Yuga and is the author of the Agastya Samhita, a major work in Ayurveda.

Agastya is also known as the patron deity of the Agastya Muni Temple located in Tirunallar, Tamil Nadu, India. The temple is believed to have been established during the Chola dynasty, between the 10th and 12th centuries.
